synthesis_notes: Initial dynamic-array-write route lowered to large variable slices; flat synthesis was stopped after excess resource use.
A hierarchical synthesis experiment was killed with exit 137 at flattening; not counted as validation.
Final shared route and switch use static connections/selections with unchanged arbitration, valid and invalid data semantics.
All final netlists use complete synth -flatten -noabc, pre/post check -assert, emitted-netlist check and zero SCC.
CXXFLAGS=-O0 accelerates selected simulator builds; Verilator RTL optimizations remain enabled.
limitations: Public adapter supports FU inputs 1..4, exactly 2 FU outputs, tile inputs/outputs 1..8; four concrete parameter points validated.
Program storage survives reset; never-programmed memory zero in Python/Verilator is not an ASIC initialization guarantee.
Native host output queue adds minimum one cycle latency and at most one return per two cycles.
Runtime programming can change an offered control word; configure while stopped.
Context/Streaming/FU sidebands are not exposed; accepted commands do not imply those execution features.
Illegal address/destination/parameter assertions are RTL simulation diagnostics, not synthesized hardware error handling.
No new system kernel, PPA, or remote CI result is claimed.
commit_and_push: Evidence generated before commit/push; Git is authoritative
